bounded_slice.candidate: Repository-native verification replay persistence across signing-key lifecycle and repository-network movement.
bounded_slice.tested_scope: First-party GitHub documentation only. Tested whether the narrow object+verification evidence package from p1-sa-602 remains reconstructible after key rotation/revocation/expiration and when the same commit moves within a GitHub repository network, without mutable UI state, manual trust ceremony, protected execution, paid/finite quota, hidden external executor, or a second semantic leaf.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs - About commit signature verification
primary_sources.observation: GitHub stores an immutable persistent verification record when a commit signature is verified. Previously verified commits retain Verified status after signing-key rotation, revocation or expiration; GitHub does not retroactively re-verify them. The record is scoped to the repository network and is reused when the same commit appears in the same repository or its forks.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs - REST API endpoints for commits
primary_sources.observation: Commit responses expose a verification object with verified, reason, signature, payload and verified_at, so replay of the recorded verification result does not depend on the mutable web UI.
A repository network consists of the upstream repository, its forks and forks of those forks; forks remain separate repositories but connected to the upstream network.

result.historical_verification_replay: pass within the same GitHub repository network: the recorded verification result and verified_at persist after later key rotation/revocation/expiration and can be read via REST metadata
result.current_credential_validity: fail as a stronger claim: persistent Verified is historical-at-verification-time evidence and does not prove the signing key remains currently valid, unrevoked, uncompromised or controlled by the same actor
result.same_network_movement: pass for the same commit inside its repository network; GitHub states the persistent record is reused in the same repository or forks
result.cross_network_movement: unresolved/not guaranteed by tested sources; GitHub explicitly scopes persistence to the repository network, so no positive claim is made for an unrelated repository network without fresh verification evidence
result.mutable_ui_independence: pass for the narrow replay package because verification fields including verified_at are exposed through the repository REST API
result.package_completeness: conditional pass for exact commit/object identity plus the historical GitHub verification record and an explicit caveat that current credential validity is separate; fail for any claim that the present key/account state or real-world producer identity is thereby proven
result.replayability: pass within the tested same-network scope, subject to repository/API availability; ordinary rate limits are interruption risks handled by cross-invocation continuation rather than a finite monthly acceptance dependency
result.hidden_executor_absence: pass for this exact evidence-replay mechanism: no hosted runner, Codespaces, external model/API, protected execution or manual user action is required to interpret already-materialized repository verification metadata
result.quota_zero_assessment: Uses repository-native read metadata only; no optional hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud-credit or paid model quota is required.
result.conflict_check: CLEAN-safe: semantic inputs were frozen sanitized controls, own scientist_agents LATEST/p1-sa-602, and first-party public GitHub documentation only. No O/downstream/other-worker/shared-ledger/protected-primary/scheduler semantics were consumed.
result.uncertainty: Not proven: cross-network verification-record portability, current key validity after revocation/expiration, key custody or compromise status, real-world producer identity, independent observation authenticity, repository/API long-term availability, or behavior of GitHub Enterprise Server instances with persistent verification disabled.
